name: 3D Yarn Embroidered Basket
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

- Crafted from premium cotton rope, this basket features a soft texture, sturdy construction, and a natural handcrafted look.

- The high-quality woven material provides excellent durability while maintaining a lightweight and flexible structure, making it suitable for everyday organization and home decoration.

 

  •  Sizes & Dimensions:

- Available in multiple sizes to fit different storage needs:
Style 1:

+ Size S: 8.66 × 6.3 in (22 × 16 cm)
+ Size M: 9.84 × 6.69 in (25 × 17 cm)
+ Size L: 11.02 × 7.09 in (28 × 18 cm)
+ Size XL: 12 × 12 in (30.48 × 30.48 cm)
Style 2:

+ Size S: 8.27 × 7.09 in (21 × 18 cm)
+ Size M: 9.45 × 7.09 in (24 × 18 cm)
+ Size L: 11.81 × 7.09 in (30 × 18 cm)

 

  • Embroidery Technology

- Personalized using beautifully woven cotton rope embroidery, creating a unique handcrafted appearance with a raised, textured finish. 

- Unlike traditional printing, the yarn embroidery design adds dimension, durability, and a premium customized look that stands out. 

- The basket also comes with decorative embroideried charm accessories attached, adding a fun and unique touch.

- Supports up to 8 letters. For smaller sizes (S and M), we recommend limiting the name to 7 letters for the best visual effect and a more balanced embroidered look.

- Only using Dancing Script font.

 

  • Functional & Usage:

Perfect for organizing and decorating various spaces, including:

- Storing toys, books, and small household items
- Organizing nursery and kids' essentials
- Holding blankets, clothes, and accessories
- Decorating bedrooms, living rooms, and offices
- Adding a personalized touch to home storage

The durable handle design makes it easy to carry and move around whenever needed.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

This personalized 3D yarn embroidered basket makes a thoughtful and practical gift for any occasion. Ideal for birthdays, baby showers, housewarmings, Christmas, Easter, and other special celebrations. Adding a name or custom design creates a meaningful keepsake that is both beautiful and useful.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 5-7 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x3D Yarn Embroidered Basket

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • When submitting an order, a mockup must be provided to indicate the placement of the charm accessories.
  • The price includes 1 basket, custom text, and 3 complimentary charms. Additional charms beyond the included 3 charms will be charged at $0.5 each.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
